## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the provider or presentation boundary
affected.

## Validation

- [ ] Debug x64 configured, built, and tested
- [ ] Release x64 configured, built, and tested
- [ ] Project-owned formatting passed
- [ ] Relevant CLI and/or GUI smoke test passed
- [ ] Package candidates verified when packaging changed
- [ ] Dependency and license notices updated when dependencies changed
- [ ] No credentials, certificates, source media, logs, or build output added

## Security, privacy, and licensing

Describe untrusted-input handling, output integrity, logging/privacy impact,
codec or patent considerations, and any known limitations.
